title: Mandate
description: What one task allows: the user's explicit instructions. A mandate always wins over the profile.

intent.description: The user's instruction in plain language.

task_type.description: Category used to key trust, e.g. 'software', 'groceries', 'gift_shopping'.

min.description: Spending less is also a miss (e.g. gifts).

allowed_categories.description: Merchant categories allowed. Empty or missing = any.

deadline.description: Spending is refused after this date.

approval.description: auto = trust tier decides; always = every purchase needs approval; shortlist = agent proposes options, user picks.

secrecy.description: Surprise: ship to the user, no notifications to the recipient.

recipient.description: Free-form notes about who the purchase is for.

benchmark_price.description: Optional fair-price reference used for efficiency scoring.
